text: 1. Front page of the passport. 2. Proof of highest educational attainment. If the applicant is a student, a pre-graduation certificate or a certificate of being a student in school issued by the school where he/she is enrolled must be submitted. 3. Academic Transcript. The scanned copy of the transcript should include the grades from the undergraduate or master's study period up to the most recent semester. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese or English translation and notarization must be provided as well. 4. Recommendation Letters. Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, written in either Chinese or English. 5. Study Plan in China. The study plan should be written in either Chinese or English, and it should be no less than 1000 words. 6. Research Achievements: Published papers / Award certificates / Invention patents, etc. can serve as evidence of one's academic achievements and research capabilities. 7. "Foreigner Physical Examination Record Form". It should be filled out in Chinese or English. Download link: http://cie.xsyu.edu.cn/info/1066/2118.htm. 8. Language proficiency certificates, such as HSK certificates, IELTS/TOEFL/ Duolingo test scores, or official English teaching qualification certificates. 9. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese/English translation and notarization are required. 10. Applicants for the doctoral program should contact the intended supervisor in advance and obtain the "Acceptance Letter from the Supervisor" from the university. The information of doctoral supervisors and the download link for the acceptance letter can be found at: http://cie.xsyu.edu.cn/info/1066/2117.htm.
